title: Social Media and Depression Symptoms: A Network Perspective
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-person network
limitations: - Student sample (non-clinical); - Potential recall bias; - Data did not meet all assumptions of multivariate normality; - No formal test for centrality differences between groups; - Limited power to detect small edge coefficients in partial correlation network.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether it was preregistered. The authors mention that data, materials, and findings have not been shared online prior to resubmitting the revised manuscript, which may imply a lack of preregistration. However, this is not definitive.
